## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated my deal in `data/deals/2026/`
- [ ] Added a square SVG or PNG logo, 100 KB or smaller, to `assets/sponsors/2026/`
- [ ] Added my slot to `data/sponsors/2026.json`
- [ ] Ran `pnpm --dir www run data:sync` (or I'd like a maintainer to run it)
- [ ] My offer is a real Black Friday or Cyber Monday deal and the details are accurate

See [SPONSORS.md](https://github.com/greatfrontend/black-friday-cyber-monday-deals/blob/main/SPONSORS.md) for the full steps.
